items.title: Ram, Jeep parent Stellantis reports profit and sales jump, but only reaffirms full-year guidance
items.summary: Ram, Jeep, and Fiat parent company Stellantis reported decent first-half results on Thursday morning, but only reaffirmed its prior guidance. Investors clearly want more from CEO Antonio Filosa's turnaround plan.

items.title: Vertiv stock sinks on earnings miss: A look at key AI infrastructure players
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings (VRT) stock sinks on Wednesday after missing its second quarter earnings estimates despite its increase to full-year guidance. Vertiv is a major player in AI data center infrastructure. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to weigh in on the outlook for the rest of the major companies participating in the AI infrastructure buildout.

items.title: Farley doubles down on Ford's pursuit of profits beyond core business
items.summary: Ford CEO Jim Farley told Wall Street the carmaker is in discussions for more U.S. Defense work and hinted at more adjacent businesses to come.

items.title: Ford Motor Stock Can Keep Climbing Without Selling More Vehicles
items.summary: A high-margin subscription and parts business compounding behind the trucks is the strongest reason Ford stock's climb can continue.

items.title: Why Ford (F) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of automotive manufacturer Ford (NYSE:F) jumped 3.8% in the afternoon session after the company reported mixed second-quarter results where a significant beat on profit expectations overshadowed a revenue shortfall.

items.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: General Motors and Ford Motor
items.summary: General Motors and Ford both topped Q2 estimates and raised outlooks, but GM's stronger earnings growth and margins helped it stand out after results.

items.title: Ford (F) Lands Its Biggest Army Truck Contract Since The Cold War
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) has secured its largest U.S. military contract since the Cold War. The company will build F Series based tactical truck prototypes for the U.S. Army. The program centers on heavy duty infantry squad vehicles that adapt Ford's core truck platform for military use. For investors watching Ford Motor, this contract adds a new dimension to a story that has recently focused on valuation debates, joint ventures, and European operations. items.summary: ↗️ Ford Motor (F): Despite posting a drop in second-quarter revenue, the automaker boosted its full-year earnings outlook.
